# Rework round 8 — claims (audit revision_7)

- R7-1: closed — on a past-due plan the reset payments are the due dates after the latest due date before today, so every installment past due, however many, stays in the amount past due and none is also counted among the reset payments; an installment due today counts among the reset payments; the one sentence serves the re-divide and re-amortize methods and the standard method alike.
- O7-1: closed — a reset plan is recognised by its monthly payment or its plan APR differing from the plan's own, and a reset that would change neither is not made, so the recognition the payoff and the reset share cannot misfire.
- O7-2: closed — a refused reset, or one that would change nothing, works out to 0.00 and nothing is written; the rule and the compute say the same.
